posts.title: Dependency independent
posts.description: Adding a tool now takes one command. Keeping it costs you a little every day. Use what you already have, and do not switch apps for one missing feature.

posts.title: Ingestion debt
posts.description: AI made generating text free. Understanding got more expensive. What 44 papers say about the gap, and the loop that closes it.

posts.title: The second brain needs a schema
posts.description: Google's Open Knowledge Format names a lesson I learned when multiple agents began writing to the same repo. Portable files are not enough. A second brain compounds only when every writer shares a schema.
